title: VibeMC
description: Officially endorsed modpack for VibeMC, mainly containing client-side QOL and performance mods.
body:
VibeMC is a custom modpack specifically designed for the server [aptly named VibeMC] with many performance and quality of life tweaks.

This modpack includes many performance enhancing mods such as Sodium, Lithium, etc. to incrase performance.

This modpack also includes quality of life gameplay mods such as Xaeros Minimap, Plasmo Voice, AppleSkin, BetterF3 and more to enhance the user experience.

The pack includes a custom main menu, as well as Faithful x32 and BSL Shaders already installed.
